ChartField Request Form (CFR)
Creating a Faculty Start-Up Project
Start-Up Projects are created for new faculty to record expenses outlined in their offer letter. Projects should have both a and a .
Start-Up Project at a Glance
Funding Structure
  • Unrestricted (UR) project
  • Typically sits within the department
  • Funded at year-end based on actual expenses incurred
  • Funding shared between the Dean’s Office and the Department according to:
    • Cost share guidelines
    • Terms outlined in the MOU
How the Project Is Created
  • Department requester submits a Project ChartField Request Form in ARC
  • Request includes required project details and supporting information
  • Request is reviewed and approved by the Dean’s Office
Outcome
Once approved, the project is established so the faculty member can record and track start-up expenses tied to their offer package.

5% Administrative Fee on Start-Up Projects
The 5% administrative fee does not count against the unrestricted Start-Up funding available to the faculty member. If the faculty member receives $50,000 in Start-Up funding, the full $50,000 remains available for faculty spending excluding the administrative fee. The fee is part of the overall Project expenses funded by the Dean's Office and the Department according to the cost-share agreement.
